newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura made largest brokerage profit in Apr - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nomura made largest brokerage profit in Apr - paper.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd was the most profitable brokerage in Japan in April despite a scandal concerning illegal stock deals, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Sunday.
Nomura made a profit of 29.2 billion yen before deducting such items as salaries and depreciation of equipment, thanks to its strong bond operations, the paper said.
The next most profitable brokerage was Daiwa Securities Co Ltd with a profit of 11 billion yen.
Nikko Securities Co Ltd and made a profit of 3.4 billion yen Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd 2.7 billion yen, the paper said.
Spokesmen for the companies declined to confirm the report.
Since the scandal surfaced in March, Nomura has been barred from participating in a number of syndicates for underwriting major corporate bonds.

Japan's Ministry of Finance said earlier in May that it has suspended Nomura from underwriting government-guaranteed bonds until the implementation of administrative punishments against the brokerage proposed by the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC).
